**Reward learning and recipient choice, 6 October 2026:** the [accepted retrospective reanalysis](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/REWARD-LEARNING-AND-RECIPIENT-CHOICE.md) reconstructs all 385 saved respondents and 12,320 offered decisions from Experiment 3 of Zhang and Hackel (2025). This is uncertain evidence, not equivalence or identified value acquisition. A mathematical counterexample separates acquired target evaluation from unmeasured private-payoff expectancy; post-task awareness supplies no randomized mediation test. Exact sources, computational freeze, independent reconstruction and an unresolved one-person awareness discrepancy are [preserved](_process/research/2026-10-05-concern-theory/reward-association/INTEGRATION.md). This advances requirement 5 while the understanding → justified concern → effective, corrigible action connection remains central.

**A quantitative test of unchanged evaluation, 6 October 2026:** [the bounded-identification result](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/VALUATION-IDENTIFICATION-BOUNDS.md) derives a sharp offered-choice envelope from a justified choice-score budget, paired coverage and the two marginal response levels. Twenty-seven Lean audits verify the finite rational probability theorem, general sharpness construction and rational-odds certificates; separate analytical and numerical review covers logistic interpretation, uncertainty and counterexamples. Equal mean responses or belief reports cannot supply paired latent bounds. This makes the preceding unrun discriminator quantitatively testable and advances requirement 5. The existing data do not establish the required calibration, so their estimates remain unchanged; rejection would challenge a restricted model class, not uniquely establish acquired concern or ethical warrant. The central successor and justified-action connection remains ongoing.

The 333-participant primary contrast is +0.50 percentage points with approximate 95% interval [−4.25, +5.24]; all fixed sensitivity intervals include zero. The result establishes neither equivalence nor a positive full-sample effect. Choice transfer alone cannot distinguish a changed target-value term from changed private-payoff expectancy. Original sources, planned calculations, counterexample and internal review are preserved; empirical and ethical identification remain separate obligations of the same unified foundation.

**Bounded alternatives now have a testable ceiling, 6 October 2026:** [valuation-identification bounds](unified-2026-10-05/VALUATION-IDENTIFICATION-BOUNDS.md) quantify how much offered target-directed responding can change with unchanged evaluation under independently justified nuisance and coverage assumptions. The sharp bound uses marginal response levels while retaining selection ambiguity. Twenty-seven Lean audits and separate mathematical/numerical review establish the conditional result. No participant data are reanalyzed, and calibrated measurement remains necessary before empirical use. This advances the existing learning-to-evaluation discriminator within the same foundation goal.
